notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first runs Abu Bakr → Abd Allah b. Numayr; the second starts at «وحدثنا ابن نمير» and its «أبي» is the father, by relation. Both continue to the names written once after them (shared tail).
«- ونحن يومئذ في رجب -» is a remark of time between dashes: left out.
Sa'id is asked and answers, then Ibn Abbas is the last link (rule 5).
